## Task
Improve the post-route quality of `cmp32` (32-bit registered unsigned comparator: y = (a < b)) without changing its behavior.

## Specification (current RTL, also the equivalence reference)
```verilog
module cmp32 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire valid_i,
    input wire [31:0] a_i,
    input wire [31:0] b_i,
    output reg valid_o,
    output reg [0:0] y_o
);

wire lt_0 = (a_i[31:0] < b_i[31:0]);
wire eq_0 = (a_i[31:0] == b_i[31:0]);

wire cmp_0 = lt_0;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        valid_o <= 1'b0;
        y_o <= 1'd0;
    end else begin
        valid_o <= valid_i;
        if (valid_i)
            y_o <= cmp_0;
    end
end
endmodule
```
Your design must be cycle-for-cycle equivalent to this module from reset: same ports, synchronous active-low reset, `valid_o` follows `valid_i` one cycle later, and `y_o` updates only on valid cycles and holds otherwise.

## Flow and objective
Yosys/ABC synthesis to the Nangate45 library, then OpenROAD placement, clock tree synthesis and routing with a 10 ns clock and a fixed floorplan. Score = 10 * WNS_ns - 0.001 * area_um2, where WNS is the worst setup slack after routing and area is total standard-cell area. Higher is better.

This RTL measured: area 268.926 um^2, WNS 7.62112 ns, score 75.942274.

## Rules
- One module of synthesizable Verilog-2005 (no helper modules or instances; the equivalence checker compares flat modules). The module name and ports must not change.
- No initial blocks, system tasks, compiler directives or technology cells.
- place_and_route budget: 4 submissions. Every submission counts, including failed ones.
- At most 30 tool calls in total.

Tools available: place_and_route, finish. Your score is the best verified place_and_route score. Call finish when you are done.

content.text: I'll start with a balanced prefix-tree comparator, which should cut the logic depth far below the ripple structure ABC infers from `<`.

Interesting — the explicit prefix tree gave essentially the *same* result as the baseline (7.594 vs 7.621 ns, area within 1%). That suggests ABC canonicalizes the comparator logic, and ~2.0 ns of the 2.4 ns path is fixed overhead (input delay), with only ~0.4 ns of real logic. The remaining lever is the logic levels *after* the comparator (the enable mux + synchronous-reset gate). Let me test both comparator styles with the reset/enable folded out of the critical path.

Now a clearer picture: all four points cluster at WNS 7.59–7.63 and area 265–272, i.e. ~2.0 ns of the 2.4 ns path is fixed (input delay) and ABC canonicalizes the comparator cone. Best so far is submission 2 (76.06). For the last shot I'll use a structure that is both one level shallower and much smaller: an equality-OR-tree driving a mux tree, where each leaf exploits the don't-care (when two bits differ, `lt = b`), so no per-bit AND/INV level is needed and only ~95 cells are required.
